result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure in a residential setting. However, safety is compromised by the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals and significant visual obstructions from vehicles parked close to the crossing.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large red SUV is parked very close to the crosswalk, significantly blocking the sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, near the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by traffic lights but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Roadway Surface Degradation
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the roadway and near the crosswalk area could cause tripping or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals within a mixed-use urban environment. Pedestrian safety is compromised by the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and visual obstructions from utility poles and parked vehicles near the crossing points.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide sufficient crossing time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obscure sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection, particularly near the market building.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance, improve pedestrian visibility, and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps with tactile warning strips. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide turning radii and lack of physical buffers like curb extensions may allow for higher vehicle speeds during turns.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A large white trailer/van is parked close to the intersection, potentially blocking sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, along the curb.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features sidewalks and a traffic signal but lacks essential pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The presence of trolley tracks and degraded pavement further reduces the quality of the walking environment.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the building

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Exposed tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard or catch bicycle tires.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light poles.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points.
